scope: Source inspection and arithmetic; no game-play simulation or player validation.

modelAssumptions.note: Hypothetical budget samples, not outputs from named card combinations.

namedElectricBuild.assumptions: Pistol; fully maintained E4 mark; every third primary attack completes E3; no enemies for extra chain jumps; no energy shortage; student haste used on cooldown. Analytical estimate, not a battle simulation.
